#!/usr/bin/env bash
# sessions/a7/mutations.sh — A7 Step 6: mutations and fresh import (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, "Evidence and frame strips",
# row "Mutations and fresh import"). Written by the agent (Step 6 session); Kiran reviews and runs it.
#
# Usage, from the repository root:   bash sessions/a7/mutations.sh
#
# For each of M1-M4:
#   a) adds a detached worktree at ../a7-mutate from HEAD (uncommitted changes in the main tree are NOT in it);
#   b) applies one exact text replacement after checking the old text occurs exactly once (M4: none);
#   c) runs `godot --headless --path godot --import` in the worktree (no godot/.godot there: an empty cache);
#   d) runs the named read-back test through the worktree's ./scripts/run-test.sh at 60 fps;
#   e) removes the worktree with `git worktree remove --force`, also after a failure (EXIT trap).
# Evidence goes to evidence/a7-mutations/ in the main repository: summary.txt (one row per mutation),
# fail_lines.txt (every FAIL and track-problem line of every test log), and per mutation <M>_diff.txt,
# <M>_import.txt and <M>_<test>_60fps.log. Nothing else in the main working tree is written.
# Exit status: 0 only if M1-M3 are CONFIRMED and M4 PASSED AS EXPECTED; 1 otherwise (after writing the summary).

set -Eeuo pipefail
trap 'rc=$?; echo "STOPPED: command \"$BASH_COMMAND\" failed with exit $rc (line $LINENO)" >&2' ERR

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- preflight (nothing is created before these pass)

REPO="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
if [ "$(pwd -P)" != "$(cd "$REPO" && pwd -P)" ]; then
	echo "STOPPED: run this from the repository root: $REPO" >&2
	exit 1
fi
WT="$(cd "$REPO/.." && pwd -P)/a7-mutate"
EV="$REPO/evidence/a7-mutations"
if [ -e "$WT" ]; then
	echo "STOPPED: $WT already exists. Check what it is and remove it yourself; this script never touches it." >&2
	exit 1
fi
wt_list="$(git worktree list --porcelain)"
if grep -qxF "worktree $WT" <<<"$wt_list"; then
	echo "STOPPED: git still registers a worktree at $WT (directory gone). Check, then run: git worktree prune" >&2
	exit 1
fi
if [ -e "$EV/summary.txt" ] || [ -e "$EV/fail_lines.txt" ]; then
	echo "STOPPED: $EV already holds results; move them aside first so earlier evidence is not overwritten." >&2
	exit 1
fi
for tool in git godot timeout awk sed grep wc tr cp; do
	if ! command -v "$tool" > /dev/null; then
		echo "STOPPED: required command not found: $tool" >&2
		exit 1
	fi
done
if [ ! -x scripts/run-test.sh ]; then
	echo "STOPPED: scripts/run-test.sh missing or not executable" >&2
	exit 1
fi

GODOT_VERSION="$(godot --version)"

	exit "$status"
}

CLEAN_TRIGGER=""
OVERLAY_TRIGGER=""
select_land() {  # variant(clean|overlay) outdir log ext
	local variant="$1" outdir="$2" log="$3" ext="$4" label="land $1"
	local result trig n tf td aligned tp rel fi line pose clip t tick cell rel_tick rig tag expect png ok
	map_run "$label" "$outdir" "$log"
	result="$( { strip_ansi "$log" | grep -E '^LAND PREVIEW: .* problems=0$'; } || true)"
	if [ -z "$result" ]; then
		stop "$label: no 'LAND PREVIEW: ... problems=0' line in $log (see its PROBLEM lines)"
	fi
	trig="$( { strip_ansi "$log" | grep -E '^TRIGGER '; } || true)"
	n=0
	if [ -n "$trig" ]; then
		n="$(wc -l <<< "$trig" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
	fi
	if [ "$n" != "1" ]; then
		stop "$label: expected exactly one TRIGGER line in $log, found $n"
	fi
	tf="$(kv "$trig" frame)"
	td="$(kv "$trig" touchdown_tick)"
	aligned="$(kv "$trig" aligned)"
	if [ "$aligned" != "true" ]; then
		stop "$label: TRIGGER line says aligned=$aligned: $trig"
	fi
	tp=$((tf - F0))
	if [ ! -f "$outdir/$(png_name "$tp")" ]; then
		stop "$label: TRIGGER frame $tf -> PNG index $tp, but $outdir/$(png_name "$tp") does not exist"
	fi
	echo "$label: TRIGGER frame=$tf (touchdown tick $td) -> PNG index $tp = $(png_name "$tp")"
	if [ "$variant" = "clean" ]; then
		CLEAN_TRIGGER="$tf/$tp"
	else
		OVERLAY_TRIGGER="$tf/$tp"
	fi
	for rel in -1 0 1 2 3 4; do
		fi=$((tf + rel))
		png=$((fi - F0))
		line="$(frame_line "$fi")"
		if [ -z "$line" ]; then
			stop "$label: no FRAME line for trigger $rel (frame $fi)"
		fi
		pose="$(kv "$line" pose)"
		clip="$(kv "$line" clip)"
		t="$(kv "$line" t)"
		tick="$(kv "$line" tick)"
		cell="$(kv "$line" cell)"
		rel_tick=$((tick - td))
		ok=1
		case "$rel" in
			-1)
				[ "$pose" = "FALL" ] && [ "$clip" = "-" ] || ok=0
				tag="trig-1_FALL"
				expect="Airborne FALL before contact"
				;;
			4)
				[ "$pose" = "IDLE" ] && [ "$clip" = "-" ] && [ "$rel_tick" = "8" ] || ok=0
				tag="trig+4_tick8_IDLE-handoff"
				expect="Tick 8: IDLE hand-off without a pop, seam or anchor shift"
				;;
			*)
				rig=$((2 * rel))
				if [ "$pose" != "LAND" ] || [ "$clip" != "land" ] || [ "$rel_tick" != "$rig" ] || ! near_frame "$t" "$rig"; then
					ok=0
				fi
				case "$rel" in
					0) tag="trig+0_rig0_impact"; expect="Frame 0: partial squash and planted feet" ;;
					1) tag="trig+1_rig2_deepest-squash"; expect="Frame 2: deepest squash, about the height of the low box" ;;
					2) tag="trig+2_rig4_same-squash"; expect="Frame 4: same squash, now beginning recovery" ;;
					3) tag="trig+3_rig6_eased-rise"; expect="Frame 6: eased rise, joined cut and fixed feet" ;;
				esac
				;;
		esac
		if [ "$ok" != "1" ]; then
			stop "$label: trigger $rel (frame $fi) does not show what the strip needs ($tag): $line"
		fi
		check_size "$label" "$outdir/$(png_name "$png")"
		keep "$outdir" "$ext" "$(png_name "$png")" "land_${variant}_${tag}_png$(printf "%0${W}d" "$png").png" \
			"$fi" "$png" "$tick" "$pose" "$clip" "$t" "$cell" "$expect"
	done
}
